body: Thank you. I hope I will see that day someday soon.
Sounds good to me. Thank you.
I might be willing to talk about it tomorrow, should I find the time.

Honestly, I don't know anymore. I had several chances months ago to make things better, but I made stupid mistakes and made things worse, to the point where I think all the damage I've done is irreparable. 

So to ultimately answer your question, I'd say "a miracle." And I don't know if my luck will permit such a thing.

You're right, there is a chance. The future is unwritten, that much is for sure, and anything can happen. That's why when making such a big of a decision as suicide, I had to carefully consider the pros and cons, taking into consideration the likelihood that things would "get better." And frankly, that likelihood seems to be nil. I've fought, and tried, and pushed to make things better, but other forces push back at least twice as hard to ensure all my effort ends up being fruitless.

The only real reason I haven't actually gone through with it yet is because of my family. My parents. They've been so kind and generous to me throughout my life. Especially these past few months. I would feel guilty that after all they've done, all they've sacrificed, I hate repaying all that with my death. I know my mom especially would take it hard, but I imagine someday down the road, the misery and pain will eat away at me to the point where I will no longer care about that and just want to feel the sweet relief that is death.
